import requests
import sqlite3

def sync_users_to_api():
    conn = sqlite3.connect('customer.db')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # Get all user records
    cursor.execute("SELECT id, email, password, created_at FROM users")
    users = cursor.fetchall()
    
    for user_id, email, password, created_at in users:
        payload = {
            'user_id': user_id,
            'email': email,
            'password': password,  # Send the stored password directly
            'created_at': created_at
        }
        
        # POST to new API endpoint
        response = requests.post(
            'http://new-api.internal.company.com/api/users',
            json=payload,
            timeout=10
        )
        
        if response.status_code != 201:
            print(f"Failed to sync user {user_id}: {response.text}")
        else:
            print(f"Synced user {user_id}")
    
    conn.close()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sync_users_to_api()
    print("Sync complete")
